challenges.title: Total requests per second
challenges.blurb: Your manager asks one question: how much traffic are we serving right now, across everything?

challenges.title: Traffic per service
challenges.blurb: One number hides too much. Break the request rate down so there is one line per service.

challenges.title: Count the pods
challenges.blurb: Capacity planning wants to know how many pods each service runs. Every pod exports memory_bytes, so use that.

challenges.title: Memory panel with units
challenges.blurb: Raw numbers like 352321536 confuse everyone. Build a panel for api memory that people can actually read.

challenges.title: Database gauge
challenges.blurb: The DBA wants a gauge of active database connections on the team dashboard.

challenges.title: Hot nodes only
challenges.blurb: You only care about nodes that are in trouble. Show node CPU, but only for nodes above 80%.

challenges.title: Error ratio per service
challenges.blurb: Checkout is flaky. Compute the fraction of requests that fail with 5xx, per service, as a ratio between 0 and 1.

challenges.title: Requests per minute by method
challenges.blurb: The product team thinks in per-minute numbers. Show requests per minute, split by HTTP method.

challenges.title: Top 3 CPU pods
challenges.blurb: Build a leaderboard of the busiest pods for the capacity review.

challenges.title: Peak CPU in the last hour
challenges.blurb: A spike came and went. Show each node's highest CPU over the last hour, even though it has calmed down now.

challenges.title: Average latency per service
challenges.blurb: Users say the app feels slow. Calculate average request latency per service from the histogram's _sum and _count.

challenges.title: NOC overview
challenges.blurb: Set up a big-screen view: average node CPU as a single number, over the last hour.

challenges.title: Who's throwing errors?
challenges.blurb: PagerDuty fired "HighErrorRate", but the alert does not say which service. Find it.

challenges.title: The slow service
challenges.blurb: Latency SLO alert! Find which service got slow, and when it started.

challenges.title: Memory leak hunt
challenges.blurb: Something is slowly eating memory, but it isn't the biggest pod. Find the pod whose memory keeps growing.
